annotations.title: Get the price of an audio piece

description: FREE: shows the owner the exact price of one audio piece before anything is spent. Models: eleven_music (music bed, 3-600 seconds, metered per STARTED minute), eleven_sfx (sound effects, 0.5-22 seconds, fractional, metered per second), voiceover (speaks your prompt with a vetted voice) and soundtrack (scores a described mood). Metered models also need duration. EVERY price — flat recipes included — comes from Soclo’s own free audio quote route: read the quote, never assume a price, and pass its exact expectedCredits and pricingVersion on soclo_audio_make so a moved price refuses uncharged. Show the owner the quote and wait for their yes before making a piece.

duration.description: For eleven-metered makes, within the quoted model’s own range: eleven_music 3-600 seconds; eleven_sfx 0.5-22 seconds. Fractional seconds are fine (MAIN prices music per started minute). Use the value you quoted.

model.description: eleven_music / eleven_sfx are server-quoted and metered; voiceover / soundtrack are flat-credit recipes.
